# DNK Fabrication

> Custom metal fabrication shop in Lubbock, Texas: CNC fiber laser cutting, CNC press
> brake forming, laser and MIG/TIG welding, structural steel, architectural metalwork,
> and custom signage for commercial and industrial customers. Owner-operated, owner-answered.

## Quick facts

- **Location:** 6417 County Road 7620, Lubbock, TX 79424
- **Phone / text:** (806) 337-2087
- **Email:** dylan@dnkfabrication.com
- **Website:** https://www.dnkfabrication.com
- **Service area:** Lubbock and roughly 60 miles out as standard; farther is job-dependent, ask
- **Rating:** 5-star rated on Google
- **Ask a question any time:** the site has an AI receptionist (Art) that answers questions about capabilities and captures quote requests 24/7

## What DNK does

- **CNC fiber laser cutting** — carbon steel, stainless, and aluminum. Complex patterns,
  tight tolerances, clean edges. Carbon steel up to 3/4 inch thick; stainless and aluminum
  at lower practical ceilings (ask for a specific thickness).
- **CNC press brake forming** — in-house since September 2026. Laser cut and formed under
  one roof: brackets, enclosures, flanges, channels, and formed sheet/plate parts with
  repeatable angles part after part. No second shop in the loop.
- **Hole patterns and features cut, not machined** — hole patterns, slots, notches, tabs,
  and mounting features in extrusions, tube, channel, plate, and brackets are cut on the
  laser in seconds instead of drilled, punched, or milled. No layout, no drill jig, no tool
  changes. Same setup for a run of 1 or 1,000.
- **Custom metalwork** — structural and decorative fabrication built to your drawings or
  developed from a concept: gates, frames, panels, supports.
- **Architectural fencing** — laser-cut modular fence systems with custom infill patterns,
  bolt-together design, powder-coat finish options, for commercial properties and developments.
- **Custom signage** — multi-layer cut steel signage for businesses, properties, and
  landmarks; designed, fabricated, and installed.
- **Commercial / volume projects** — production fabrication for contractors and developers,
  from your specs or developed with you.
- **Welding** — laser welding (handheld fiber), MIG, TIG, aluminum, structural steel;
  emergency field welding and metal repair.
- **Priority Response** — equipment-down service for commercial and industrial operations:
  owner-answered line, same-day design evaluation, nights and weekends available.
  See https://www.dnkfabrication.com/emergency.html

## Turnaround

- Standard jobs are typically completed within two weeks.
- An expedite lane with 24-hour turnaround exists for time-critical work.
- After-hours emergency service is available for production-down situations.

## Materials

Carbon steel, stainless steel, aluminum. Powder coating is coordinated through an outside
vendor when it is part of the finish.

## How to get a quote

Send a drawing, a STEP file, a photo, or a description to dylan@dnkfabrication.com, text or
call (806) 337-2087, or use the quote form / chat on https://www.dnkfabrication.com.
